status: DEVELOPMENT VALIDATION ONLY. Nine-fold leave-one-scene-out on validate; no held-out-split result and no selection on validate after the folds. test and Culver are not opened
the_only_change: the learning target: a classifier on the argmax label becomes a regressor on the two gains dL = Q_L - Q_E and dF = Q_F - Q_E, from the same Q table. Inputs are the 23 of round 1 and nothing else moves
decision_rule: max{0, dL_hat, dF_hat}, ties within TOL to the cheaper payload. The zero is E's own gain, so both-negative falls to E by construction
model_note: ONE multi-output forest fits both targets, which keeps one forest per fold as in the earlier rounds. Splits therefore reduce the summed variance of the two targets and the outputs are coupled. class_weight is dropped because it is a classifier-only parameter, not because a new setting was wanted; nothing new is introduced

A5_gate.what_this_proves: the classification arm below is round 1, so the only difference between the two arms is the learning target

true_gap_high_reliability.what_it_is: the separation that exists in the target itself, which is the ceiling the predicted separation beside it is trying to reach

C1_criteria.held_out_f1_above_classifier: the bootstrap interval of (regression - classification) held-out scene-equal F1 lies entirely above zero
C1_criteria.F_not_requested_loss_reduced: the summed held-out loss of "should F, chose L" and "should F, chose E" is lower than the classifier's
C1_criteria.no_new_dominant_error: the largest single held-out loss category is no larger than the classifier's largest single category

C1_verdict: all three criteria hold: the regression target is an improvement on this input
C1_note: the F request share is deliberately not a criterion
C2_consequence: if this fails as well, stop changing the random-forest configuration on this input and turn to what information is missing before the request. Do not jump to the complete feature tensor or to a new neural network
